ヘッド／テイルは月の真交点（接触軌道）。月軌道と黄道の交点です。バーテックスは黄: The nodes are the Moon's true nodes from its osculating orbit, where the lunar orbital plane meets the ecliptic. Vertex is the western intersection of the ecliptic and prime vertical.
True Lilithは月の接触軌道の遠地点を近似計算します。平均リリスは月の平: True Lilith approximates the apogee of the Moon's osculating orbit. Mean Lilith uses the apogee of its mean orbit. Neither is asteroid Lilith. Both include ecliptic latitude in 3D. Against 199 Swiss Ephemeris samples, the maximum longitude difference was about 0.16 degrees for True and 0.0007 degrees for Mean. These are sample results, not error bounds for all dates.
移動軌跡は黄経の変化を示します。ヘッド／テイルは前後360日、バーテックスは前後: Trails show changes in ecliptic longitude: 360 days before and after for the nodes, and 12 hours before and after for Vertex. Thin surrounding lines are also visible in 2D.

House divisions follow the selected system. Campanus uses great circles; Placidus uses semi-arc curves. Equal and Whole Sign extend longitude sectors to the ecliptic poles. Placidus circumpolar regions are left undrawn. Stars in circumpolar regions never rise or never set at this latitude, so the line endings fade to mark where the divisions stop.

補助線は選択中の方式に連動します。キャンパナスとレギオモンタナスは大円、プラシー: Guides follow the selected house system. Campanus and Regiomontanus use great circles; Placidus uses time-division curves. Koch shows construction lines from horizons at shifted times and the meridian; these lines intersect one another. Equal, Whole Sign and Porphyry extend ecliptic longitude sectors to the ecliptic poles. Placidus omits circumpolar regions, where stars do not rise or set, and fades the line ends.
3D天球を外から見るとき、視点から遠い側を薄暗くします。2Dと地上視点では適用し: Dims the far hemisphere when viewing the 3D sphere from outside. Not applied in 2D or ground view.
描画領域をドラッグすると視点が回転します。ホイールまたはピンチで拡大・縮小できま: Drag the chart to rotate the view. Use the wheel or pinch to zoom. When the chart has focus, use the arrow keys to rotate and +/− to zoom.
3D天球は観測地点の地平線と天頂を基準に表示します。「地上視点」では天球の内側か: The 3D sphere uses the observation site’s horizon and zenith. Ground view looks at the sky from inside the sphere. The 2D chart projects ecliptic longitude onto a circle with the ASC on the left. Selecting a body highlights its related aspects.
地上視点の「地平線下も表示」は初期状態でONです。OFFにすると地平線より下の天: Show below horizon is on by default in ground view. Turning it off hides bodies and lines below the horizon. Rendering includes surface parallax at sea level, but not atmospheric refraction or terrain occlusion. The body list and aspect calculations use geocentric values.
「太陽系儀」は太陽を中心に、惑星と月の配置を表示します。惑星間の距離は対数圧縮し: Orrery shows the planets and Moon around the Sun. Interplanetary distances are logarithmically compressed, and body sizes and the Earth–Moon distance are enlarged. Displayed distances and sizes are not to scale.
軌道線は、指定日時の位置と速度から求めた接触軌道です。その日時の運動状態を二体問: Orbit guides are osculating orbits derived from position and velocity at the selected time. They represent the instantaneous state as a two-body ellipse, rather than predicting the actual future path. The Moon’s orbit guide is centered on Earth.
惑星と月は表面模様を付けた球で、感受点は菱形で表示します。土星と天王星には環を描: Planets and the Moon are textured spheres; sensitive points are diamonds. Saturn and Uranus have rings. The orrery uses rotation-axis directions and rotation periods. Rotation angles use constant periods from a reference epoch and do not guarantee the observed orientation of surface features. Shading comes from illustration lighting and is not intended to reproduce lunar phases or eclipses.
背景にはHipparcos星表から抽出した22星を表示します。座標には固有運動・: The background shows 22 stars selected from the Hipparcos catalogue. Coordinates include proper motion, precession and nutation, but not annual aberration, annual parallax or atmospheric refraction. Stars are hidden in 2D.
テーマは「ライト」「ダーク」「システム設定に従う」「現地の空」から選べます。「シ: Choose Light, Dark, Follow system or Local sky. Follow system tracks changes to your device’s light/dark setting while the page is open. Your selected theme also applies in Live sky.
「現地の空」は、観測地点と日時から求めた太陽高度に応じて、晴天の昼・薄明・夜を近: Local sky approximates clear daylight, twilight and night from the Sun’s altitude at the selected place and time. In ground view, sky colors follow the horizon and Sun’s direction, and background stars disappear in daylight. Body markers and aspects remain visible. Weather, moonlight and light pollution are not modeled.
ライセンス・クレジットのページは、端末のライト／ダーク設定に合わせて表示します。: The licenses and credits page follows your device’s light/dark setting independently of the theme chosen manually in the observation screen.
入力できる日時は1800〜2200年、緯度は−89〜89°です。「出生データを入: Dates span 1800–2200 and latitude spans −89 to 89°. Choosing a city in Enter birth data uses the browser’s time-zone information to determine the UTC offset, including daylight saving time. Nonexistent and repeated local times are checked during entry.
UTC差は入力時に確定し、その後の時間再生中は固定します。画面下の直接入力欄では: The UTC offset is fixed when you apply the input and remains fixed during playback. The direct input fields below the chart allow a manual UTC offset. The selected location affects the horizon, ASC, MC, houses and ground view.
天球の基本10天体はAstronomy Engineで地球中心・トロピカル黄道の: Astronomy Engine calculates the 10 main bodies in geocentric tropical ecliptic coordinates. Eight additional bodies use interpolated geocentric vectors from NASA/JPL Horizons, converted to the ecliptic of the selected date. Interpolation errors were below one arcsecond in 240 comparison samples; this is not an accuracy guarantee for every date.
アスペクトは黄経差で判定し、主要5種とマイナー6種を扱います。オーブは種類ごとに: Aspects use ecliptic longitude differences, with five major and six minor types. Each type has an adjustable orb from 0 to 10°. Angular separation on the celestial sphere, shown when a body is selected, is a separate value that also includes ecliptic latitude.
複合アスペクトは6種を検出し、構成するすべての辺が種類別オーブを満たす場合に金色: Six compound patterns are detected and drawn in gold when every required edge meets its type’s orb. Detection is independent of ordinary line type and group switches. Turning Aspect lines off hides both ordinary and compound lines.
ハウスはプラシーダス・キャンパナス・コッホ・レギオモンタナス・ポーフィリー・イコ: Choose from seven house systems: Placidus, Campanus, Koch, Regiomontanus, Porphyry, Equal from ASC and Whole Sign. The 2D house lines and numbers are on by default; 3D house lines are off by default. Their visibility is controlled independently.
3Dハウス線は黄道上の境界を示します。「スフィアの補助線」の「ハウス分割」では、: 3D house lines mark boundaries on the ecliptic. House divisions under Sphere guides also shows construction lines for the selected system. When Placidus or Koch cannot be calculated, the reason is shown and the boundaries are hidden. The app does not switch to another system automatically.
感受点はドラゴンヘッド・テイル、バーテックス、リリスです。ヘッドとテイルは月の真: Sensitive points are the North and South Nodes, Vertex and Lilith. The nodes are calculated as true lunar nodes and share a visibility switch. Lilith can use True or Mean position; both describe a lunar apogee and are distinct from the asteroid Lilith.
「感受点をアスペクトに含める」をOFFにすると、感受点の描画を維持したまま判定対: Turning Include points in aspects off excludes sensitive points from detection while keeping them visible. The North–South Node pair is always excluded. Trails show longitude changes over ±360 days for the nodes and ±12 hours for the Vertex. Lilith trails are not shown.
「今の星を眺める」は選択中の地点で現在時刻に1秒ごとに同期します。視点は約4分で: Live sky uses the selected location and updates to the current time every second. The camera completes a turn in about four minutes and pauses for five seconds after interaction. Rotation can also be stopped with the button. Exit or Esc restores the observation time and camera view; theme changes made in this mode are retained. GPS is not requested automatically.
時間の自動再生は、別タブを見ている間は進みません。「滑らかな再生（補間）」は計算: Automatic time playback pauses while another tab is active. Smooth playback interpolates between calculated states, usually adding about 0.1 seconds of rendering lag. Stopping playback aligns rendering to the confirmed time. With the OS reduced-motion setting enabled, interpolation and Live sky auto-rotation are disabled.
日時・地点・天体位置の計算と都市検索は端末内で行います。追加天体の初回利用時には: Date, location and body-position calculations and city searches run on your device. First use of additional bodies loads about 3.5 MB of ephemeris data from this site; first use of the birth form loads about 6.2 MB of city data. Those requests do not include input dates, coordinates or search terms.
保存は初期状態でOFFです。「このブラウザに日時・地点を保存」と「このブラウザに: Storage is off by default. Save date and location in this browser and Save display preferences in this browser are independent options. Only enabled categories are stored locally; turning an option off deletes its stored category. Display preferences include language, theme, playback settings, houses, aspects and body/point visibility.
現在地はGPSボタンを押したときだけ、ブラウザの許可を得て取得します。取得した座: Location is requested only after you press GPS and grant browser permission. Retrieved coordinates are not sent to an app server. Location services are governed by your device and browser providers’ terms, and the page host receives normal connection information. The app includes no advertising, analytics or externally served fonts.
